itemListElement.name: One bounded issue + regression test PR

itemListElement.name: Multi-repo CI reliability sprint - up to 5 repos

Written scope, acceptance checks, milestone payment terms and repo access are agreed before work begins; this is an advertised fixed-scope offer, not received income.
